description: Animate a pet photo so the pet appears to sing a song, with the mouth synced to the audio. Takes a public URL to a photo (one pet, facing the camera, well lit works best) and a template_id from list_song_templates. Costs 1 credit. Rendering takes about a minute, so this returns immediately with a video id - poll get_video_status until it is completed.

image_url.description: Public HTTPS URL to a photo of the pet. JPEG, PNG, WebP or HEIC, up to 15MB.

name: create_singing_video
title: Create a singing pet video
